title: RPSLS (a.k.a. Rock, Paper, Scissors, Lizard, Spock)
author: jildos_legoplanet
selftext:
What started as a brainfart during watching an episode of Big Bang Theory turned into a 3+ month personal project to develop a game that is super easy to learn but extremely hard to master. The game involved a progressive learning path based on mathematical human-pattern theory (Nash Equilibrium), in-game ranking and statistics, both free to play (limited to 2 levels of The Forge singleplayer experience, or sign-up with emailaddress/google social login. The game is completely free to use / ad-free during this Beta Test. After this phase, the game will be published on Steam, Itch, Apple Store and Google Play Store
